name: Belebele: A Parallel Reading Comprehension Dataset in 122 Language Variants
description: Belebele is a massively multilingual machine reading comprehension benchmark covering 122 language variants across 115 distinct languages, 27 language families, and 29 scripts. Derived from FLORES-200 passages, each language variant contains 900 4-way multiple-choice reading comprehension questions based on 488 passages, enabling precise evaluation of language models across high-, medium-, and low-resource languages in a fully parallel evaluation setting.
